item.title: Safety and Efficacy of FSD201 for the Treatment of Chronic Pain Associated With Idiopathic MCAS (MCAD)
item.description: Terminated · Phase 2 · Fsd201 — This study will determine if FSD201 reduces the average daily 24-hour recall pain intensity after 28 and 56 days of treatment in adults with chronic widespread musculoskeletal nociplastic pain.

item.description: Suspended · Not applicable · Swimming, Cycling — Individuals with ME/CFS experience profound exercise intolerance and post-exertional malaise. item.title: Masitinib for the Treatment of Severe Mast Cell Activation Syndrome
item.description: Unknown · Phase 2 · Masitinib 4.5 Mg/Kg/Day, Best Supportive Care, Masitinib 6.0 Mg/Kg/Day — To evaluate the efficacy and safety of two dosing schemes of oral masitinib versus matching placebo in the treatment of patients suffering from severe MCAS with handicap unresponsive to optimal symptomatic treatment.
